location_note: Zahal Square Tunnel, outside the Old City walls north-west of Jaffa Gate; no map reference. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Four pottery assemblages (Byzantine-Umayyad to late Ottoman) from fills over the Early Islamic moat and Ottoman rooms (excavation: Weksler-Bdolah, 'Atiqot 104, not in this reader's units). Moat not eligible. Cisterns and shafts in the text are parallels from other sites. No feature rows.
